_doc: PRE-REGISTRATION v2 (frozen 2026-08-08 ~06:00 ET, before any run) -- ribbon-flip-back decisiveness A/B. Supersedes prereg-ribbon-flipback-buffer-2026-08-08.json, whose stop_rule correctly fired: the frozen v1 candidate ('SPY $ beyond the flip boundary') has NO code surface -- the live flip-back (heartbeat_core._ribbon_flip_fn == exit_manager_walk's replay mirror) is a bare single-tick categorical stack equality. v2 re-freezes on the two surfaces that ARE code-grounded: (1) spread_cents from backtest/lib/ribbon.py compute_ribbon (EMA-internal spread of the 3-EMA stack, in cents) as a flip-DECISIVENESS filter, and (2) confirm-closes on the categorical sequence. v1's stop was the discipline working; v2 is a NEW frozen grid, not a softening.
hypothesis: Whipsaw flips (opposing stack with thin EMA spread, or flips that un-flip next close) fire binding exits on positions that then recover; requiring a minimum opposing-stack spread_cents and/or a second confirming closed read reduces whipsaw exits without materially delaying true invalidations, UNCONDITIONALLY across regimes (trend-only win auto-fails, REGIME-EARLY-CLASSIFIER-2026-08-02).
population_and_engine: IDENTICAL to v1 prereg verbatim: pain-ledger 219 engine positions 2026-06-26..2026-08-07; reconstruct_positions + fetch_option_bars (once per position, session cache); replay ONLY via walk_exit_manager driving production plan_exit_actions.

ribbon_reconstruction.method: historical ribbon stack reconstructed by running the PRODUCTION backtest/lib/ribbon.py compute_ribbon over cached SPY 5m closes for each position's day (pure deterministic function -- the same producer the live G14 path cites), then aligned to the option 1-min bar cadence per walk_exit_manager's documented same-cadence requirement (alignment method documented in output).
ribbon_reconstruction.control_parity_stop_rule: CONTROL (reconstructed ribbon, flip modeled, all other knobs live-resolved) must reconcile with actual realized P&L within max($40, 15%) on >= 6 of 8 sampled positions BEFORE any candidate runs. Systematic divergence -> STOP, report (that would itself be a material finding: every prior exit study hardcoded ribbon_flip_back=False).

candidates_frozen.buffer_variable: ribbon_flip_back_min_spread_cents: an opposing-stack flip counts as invalidation ONLY if spread_cents >= threshold at that closed read. Thresholds = {p25, p50, p75} of spread_cents measured across ALL opposing-stack flip reads inside the population window, computed ONCE from the reconstruction BEFORE any candidate replay, pinned numerically in the scorecard (deterministic given data; no post-hoc choice).
candidates_frozen.confirm_variable: flip_back_confirm_closes in {1 (control), 2 consecutive opposing closed reads}
candidates_frozen.grid: {0, p25, p50, p75} x {1, 2} minus the (0,1) control cell = 7 candidates vs CONTROL
candidates_frozen.mechanism_note: variants change ONLY the caller-side ribbon_flip_back boolean derivation fed to plan_exit_actions; zero production-code edits; C6 -- only closed 5m reads, never the forming bar.

gates_all_must_pass: IDENTICAL to v1 prereg verbatim: G1 pooled delta>0; G2 chop-cohort >=0 (HOLD-WINNERS labels); G3 runner-cohort + J-anchor no-regression; G4 four sub-windows all >=$0 with >=5 changed trades each; G5 drop-best-day >0; G6 hard-day not worsened >$100; G7 per-account cuts both >=0 (L149); G8 BH-FDR q=0.10 across the 7 candidates; power floor >=15 changed trades else UNDERPOWERED.
verdicts: SHIP (kill_criterion: net <= -$300 over first 10 live sessions -> same-day revert) | FREEZE+CLOCK | CONTROL_HOLDS. No bar-softening after the run.
disclosures_required: v1's four disclosures PLUS: (5) ribbon reconstructed (not recorded live state) -- reconstruction-vs-live drift is possible if live compute inputs ever diverged from the SPY 5m cache; (6) pinned percentile threshold values + the n of flip reads they were measured on; (7) whipsaw-exit counts under CONTROL (how often the flip un-flips within 1-2 reads) as the mechanism's base-rate.
